_comment: v3.3 reranker RECIPE ABLATION. Identical to sweep_config_reranker_v32.json (same tasks/seeds/retrievers/epochs/topc/lr/arch and the SAME WS3 bar from runs/sweep_v2reranker) EXCEPT combine_mode=blend. This isolates one variable: v3.2's failed gate was hypothesised to be the COMBINATION RECIPE, not the v2 architecture (WS3 = same v2, deployed raw, beat v3.2 on the geometry-sensitive tasks). blend = a*z(retriever|cand)+b*z(logit(v2)|cand): v2 enters via its un-saturated pre-sigmoid logit, both signals z-standardised over the candidate set, a init 1.0 / b init 0.0 (at-init order == retriever exactly -> regression-proof preserved; the do-no-harm validation gate is unchanged), and the learned b/a ratio CAN reach the v2-dominant regime WS3 deploys. temperature stays 1.0 so the ONLY changed variable vs v3.2 is the recipe (fair A/B). Gate is identical to v3.2: on geometry-sensitive {0,3,4,5} the deployed gap_closed_frac must EXCEED the WS3 per-task bar, AND zero deployed regression on every task (esp. temporal); additionally task 2 deployed nDCG@10 must not regress vs v3.2's ~0.672.
